verdict.rationale: Bulk operations are a fair axis for an AI assistant that acts on emails, calendars and integrated apps, so the story applies. The evidence only shows that Poke can 'perform actions across apps and services through natural conversation' and read, search or draft emails. Nothing documents acting on many items at once (batch archive, bulk edit, mass updates), and the single-message API endpoint is not a bulk capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
